6.206 rsCRIMultiNonStaticGroups
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsCRIMultiNonStaticGroups is a critical error that will occur when a CustomReportItem with at least
one DataGrouping element with DataGrouping.Static set to true and at least one DataGrouping
element with DataGrouping.Static set to false occur within the same DataGroupings collection.
